speaker: Patient
text: 62-year-old male. The patient has recently immigrated to the US from Africa and seeks evaluation for a non-healing, red, crusty lesion on the shaft of his penis and a similar lesion on his left middle finger. Previous treatments in his home country for syphilis and eczema have been unsuccessful. The patient is a smoker, with a history of two packs per day for the last 30 years.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that detailed history; the combination of a chronic, non-healing ulcer on the penis and a similar lesion on your finger, along with your heavy smoking history and previous failed treatments for syphilis and eczema, raises significant concern for malignancy. Given the high suspicion for Squamous Cell Carcinoma or potentially Kaposi Sarcoma given your demographics, do you have any history of HIV, Hepatitis B/C, or other sexually transmitted infections? Also, have you noticed any lymph node swelling in your groin or armpit?
